stage: Canonical model and actual independent imported GLB feedback reviewed

iterations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Studio design reference for a fictional spacecraft model in a 3D game. The attached original pixel-art views are the authority for silhouette and colors. Model the same assembly: two thick chamfered square-section grey blocks arranged in tandem along one horizontal axis, joined by a short, much narrower rectangular connector. Leave open space around that connector. Each outside end has a thin straight axial rod with a small muted red tip. The two blocks dominate the mass. Pale blue-grey opaque metal bands wrap around the blocks, with a few seated grey service covers and small slots. Sparse maintenance details on broad surfaces, restrained joint grime, scuffs, scratches and shallow dents. No added components or dense panel grids. One large elevated side three-quarter view, one matching side view showing both blocks and rods, and one end view; every view depicts identical geometry. Neutral studio lighting, charcoal backdrop, no text. Preserve the original simple angular shape rather than inventing a streamlined vessel.

input_images.role: Actual paletted legacy shape and colour reference

verdict.verdict: Accepted art direction with legacy geometry constraints
findings: Tandem chamfered square blocks, narrow open-sided central link and opposite red-tipped axial rods are readable and consistent.
Pale blue band width, end collars and secondary covers remain interpretations; constrain their proportions against legacy headings.
Broad surfaces and restrained use marks fit the established Mauna treatment.
verdict.next_action: Compare actual imported GLB against legacy and this concept.

glb_feedback.verdict: Actual corresponding native/imported renders preserve two blocks, axial rods, narrow link and side voids, but red tip atlas assignment incorrectly selected blue-grey. Correct the recipe from tile2 to muted-red tile6.

Corrected red tips and small markers are visible. Elevated end comparison0.95 exposes too much axial length relative to legacy12/28; use a lower estimated elevation0.25, keeping geometry and scale unchanged.

Saved-native and independent GLB were reopened and rendered after the recipe correction. Actual0/4/12/28, hero, rear and wireframe inspected with all32 paletted legacy headings and concept3. Keep paired grey angular bodies, pale-blue opaque bands, red terminals and open-sided link. Camera is approximate; end-view blue field extent, hidden joints and small covers remain interpretations. Preview is darker/cooler than the original palette; final user and client acceptance separate.

glb_visual_review: Actual legacy/concept/imported feedback reviewed.59 source part names retained in four batches;58 seated contacts, two physical dents, two connector-side void rays and three occupied structure rays verified in both formats. No dense panel grid, emission or glass inferred.
next_step: One canonical model for gameplay and all menus. WorldSize160 proposal; six mounts and client scale/orientation/material calibration remain separate.
